newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's end-Nov palm oil stocks 955,965 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's end-Nov palm oil stocks 955,965 tonnes.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks rose 0.12 percent to 955,965 tonnes at end-November from 954,841 at end-October and compared with 798,399 tonnes at end-November 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Monday.

Stocks of crude palm oil were 604,845 tonnes, against 602,701 at end-October and 487,645 a year earlier. Processed palm oil stocks totalled 351,120 tonnes compared with 352,140 and 310,754 respectively, PORLA said.

Stocks of crude palm kernel oil were 61,511 tonnes at end-November against 70,804 at end-October and 49,433 at end-November 1995. Processed palm kernel oil stocks were 56,486 tonnes compared with 55,818 and 44,940 respectively.
